changes: All 21 STRICT_GATE_UNKNOWN agent seeds (h005 attempts 1 and 2) are marked SUPERSEDED_BY_CONTRACT. Their END_READ/ASK_USER labels assumed the one-minute EXACT_ONLY expiry. Under C6a (thirty-minute window, ADR-0039 Proposed) those historical moments are inside the window, so continued CHECK_AVAILABILITY is legitimate. Expiry behaviour is verified by an explicit deadline-plus-one control and by Live h005, not by these seeds.
